name: heat_time_map_30s_shortwire
description: Heat-time map for the Dynalloy coil fitted 2026-08-05: 0.08 in, 10 mm solid length, cold-stretched to 40 mm, ~20 mm design contraction, cold R ~3.5 ohm. Same protocol as heat_time_map_30s_v2 -- 30 s cool everywhere, 5+1 cycles, 20 s cold-start settle -- with the ladder and the sense guard re-derived for 3.5 ohm. 8 levels x 4 heat times = 32 conditions, ~111 min, level-ascending within each heat row, gentlest first. LADDER STARTS AT 250 mA: the LDO parks at v_idle = 0.5 V at DAC code 0, so the floor current is 0.5/3.5 = 143 mA and v2's 150 mA row would sit right on it, where the CC loop has no authority. 250 mA is 1.7x the floor and keeps v2's grid alignment, so cells are comparable to the long-wire campaign by nominal current. GUARD r_min_ohm 1.6 = ~45% of cold R, the same margin the long wire had at 2.0; it passes the 143 mA idle bias with 2.2x room. This wire is BENIGN on the soak axis that killed the 1.8 ohm coil: idle dissipation is 0.5^2/3.5 = 0.071 W, against 0.139 W at 1.8 ohm and 0.056 W on the long wire, so 30 s cool should recover. NOT CARRIED OVER FROM v2: the 950x400 exclusion was measured on the long wire. At 3.5 ohm that cell is I^2*R*t = 1.26 J, essentially the old 1.24 J saturation cap, so expect it to clip -- it is kept anyway, as clip/rail are reported columns and the pipeline does not select data. BOTH SENSORS ARE NARROWER THAN THE DESIGN STROKE. The laser amp maps only ~10.0 mm onto 0-5 V (K = -0.4978 mV/um about V0 = 2503.75 mV), and the load cell's 5 V is 493 mN. A 20 mm free contraction is 2x the entire laser window, and blocked force in a fixed grip will pass 493 mN long before that. Position the cold state at the 5 V end of the laser window so all ~10 mm is available in the contracting direction (re-fit V0 via Calibrate_LaserHead; k is unchanged by repositioning), and set the mechanical preload so the cold load-cell baseline reads ~1.8-2.0 V as it did in every healthy July sweep. If the coil still rails both channels, the specimen is out of range for this rig and needs series compliance, not a different sweep.
